title: Sunday Brunch Buffet and Mimosa Cruise on Lake Tahoe
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Savor a delightful Sunday Brunch Buffet while cruising on the stunning Lake Tahoe. This unique experience features a thoughtfully prepared spread, including a lox and bagel station, yogurt bar, egg bake, assorted pastries, and more. Enjoy a complimentary mimosa as you take in panoramic views of the crystal-clear waters, creating the perfect backdrop for a relaxed weekend getaway or special occasion. Immerse yourself in laid-back luxury while indulging in delicious food and breathtaking scenery.

- Enjoy a thoughtfully prepared brunch buffet with a variety of dishes
- One complimentary mimosa included for each guest
- Scenic views of Lake Tahoe’s crystal-clear waters
- Ideal for special occasions or elevating your Sunday routine
